records.text: And that is from a Ye (Kanye West) song. I can't think of a title. I have this weird, like, disability. It's, why can I never think of titles? It's so bizarre. Thank you, Skylar (Schuyler Pryor). It's 'Stars' by Ye (Kanye West). You would think I would know that, but I just can never remember the name of a title. It's really weird. A trial (viewer handle as transcribed) writes, 'This whole Tyler Robinson reminds me of the movie Homecoming. Good morning, Candace. Appreciate your work and your bravery. Like Ye (Kanye West) said, I like, I like the way Candace Owens thinks.'
records.speaker: Candace Owens
